reason: A voice input utility for DeepSeek Harness that captures microphone speech, converts it to text through native or browser recognition, and submits the result as a regular chat message.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供麦克风语音输入、实时转写和将识别文本作为普通聊天消息提交的功能。
summaries.en: Provides microphone voice input for DeepSeek Harness, with live speech transcription and submission of recognized text as a normal chat message.

capabilities: Performs streaming speech recognition using a native host engine or browser Web Speech
Submits recognized text as a normal chat message
Provides a configurable global hotkey and microphone button
